symptom: `listview lv (… PageSize: 200)` always pages at 20 — `mxcli check` ✓, `mx check` ✓, describe shows no PageSize
cause: The property parsed into the AST but three layers ignored it: `buildListViewV3` hardcoded `PageSize: 20`, the describe parse never read it, and the listview describe formatter never emitted it
insight: Read `w.GetIntProp("PageSize")` on write; read `w["PageSize"]` on describe; emit a non-default PageSize in the listview formatter. Test `TestBuildListViewV3_PageSize`. traceops #17
